verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a query model for ad hoc investigation. Query Builder queries have up to six clauses (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, HAVING), relational span prefixes (root., parent., child., anyX.) query across trace structure, and the docs refer to this as "Honeycomb's query language." Query Assistant (natural-language-to-query) and the API's query management add to it, and a community user says Honeycomb accelerates investigations. Missing for 10: a standalone text-syntax/operator reference showing the language is more than a GUI clause builder, and hands-on independent corroboration of the query language itself.
